text:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding smoke test (sampleapp v1.4) failed when verifying routes. SDK's listRoutes is returning compact summaries and the sampleapp expects the full REST object.

matt: which fields are missing?

anya: REST GET /v1/routes yields visibility:string, policy:{rules...}, last_deploy. SDK returns {id, name, is_public}. sampleapp checks route.visibility === 'public' and then reads policy.rules. runtime crash.

alex: we did that on purpose to reduce payloads for hot paths. But parity gap is bad for sampleapp.

sara: also noticed param name drift: REST uses visibility, SDK has is_public. breaking for string checks.

anya: repro snippet:
```
// SDK
const routes = await client.listRoutes({project: 'demo'});
// routes[0] -> { id: 'r_zee', name: 'inbound', is_public: true }
// sampleapp does: if (route.visibility !== 'public') return error
```
vs REST:
```
GET /v1/routes?project=demo
[ { id: 'r_zee', visibility: 'public', policy: { rules: [...] }, last_deploy: '2026-03-01T12:00:00Z' } ]
```

tina: side-note: onboarding webhook also hit duplicate provisioning because REST returned 429 + Retry-After but SDK's retryer ignored the header and retried faster. We saw 2x provisioning calls.

infra-bot: Alert: provisioning-duplication +9% (2026-03-23T09:22Z).@matt

matt: Ack. We need a two-step fix: quick SDK opt-in for full objects and a retry fix.

alex: Plan: (A) add includeDetails=true to listRoutes so SDK returns the REST-shaped object (no breaking change). (B) Add a compatibility layer mapping is_public <-> visibility and keep both keys for 6 months. (C) Update SDK retry to respect Retry-After header and expose preferServerRetryHeader boolean.

sara: Docs/sampleapp change: relax validation to accept either shape (visibility string OR is_public boolean) and add tests. We'll revert the relaxed check after SDK compatibility period.

anya: timelines? Critical to unblock customers using sampleapp templates today.

alex: I can land the includeDetails opt-in and a beta release today (patch). Retry change requires semver-minor and tests, aim for tomorrow. Compatibility shim also tomorrow.

matt: please also update CHANGELOG and SDK migration notes describing the shim and recommended field migration (use visibility string). callout about Retry-After support and config.

devex-bot: Created tickets: SDK-512 includeDetails param, SDK-513 retry-after support, DOCS-215 sampleapp validation loosen.

anya: I'll open a quick PR to sampleapp to accept both shapes and add unit tests. Leaving a TODO in the code pointing to SDK-512/513.

tina: thanks — once SDK beta is out I'll rerun the smoke tests and post results here. :thumbsup:
